purpose: Personajes secundarios y antagonistas futuros definidos por Character Design v4, más habitantes suplementarios con siluetas distintas.
antiCloneRules: No secondary citizen may have Lumo's golden glowing body, branched antennae and cyan chest heart.
No secondary citizen may copy Nara's all-green leafy body silhouette.
No secondary raccoon may copy Tuno's exact face, bronze goggles and utility outfit.
No secondary bird may combine Biri's blue body with orange crest feathers.
No secondary creature may copy Pompón's round purple fluffy silhouette.
No secondary fox or wolf may combine Nublo's blue-violet fur, amber eyes and mist tail.
Do not recolor a principal character and present it as a citizen.
Do not duplicate one citizen repeatedly to create a crowd.
